title: 2016 Champion PIT 데이터 수집·정규화·활용 통합 계획
objective: 2016-01-04~2016-12-29 Champion 검증 데이터를 실제 제공 가능한 출처로 수집하고, PIT-safe Silver, non-empty Gold feature, next-session smoke backtest까지 하나의 재개 가능한 실행으로 완료한다.

baseline_audit.latest_gold: 246 sessions; warmup 504/60; bar eligible 1,774/2,124; DART eligible 1,298/2,707; intersection 1,184; eligible decisions 0; feature rows 0
root_causes: daily_market Silver has 5,812,360 rows and non-null cap/shares, but retained Bronze lacks those fields; current values were inferred and are not reproducible
daily_market and investor_flow available_at are in 2026, while Gold rewrites future availability to historical session time
investor_flow has only 695 rows for 3 instruments
financial_facts latest coverage ends in 2016-03 and cannot keep earnings inputs fresh for all of 2016
corporate_actions Silver has one global 2026 sentinel although retained Bronze has about 1GB of per-instrument intervals from 2013 onward
rebuild-data calls unsupported KRX investor-flow and status/action routes and never reaches Silver, Gold, or backtest

empirical_evidence: A live KRX 2016-01-04 trade request returned 2,041 records; every record had MKTCAP and LIST_SHRS. A Saturday returned zero records.
A live KRX 2016-01-04 master request returned 2,041 records with ISU_SRT_CD, LIST_DD, LIST_SHRS, market and share-class fields; it did not expose corporate-action/status events.

The official KIS examples expose historical-date investor_trade_by_stock_daily with foreign/institution/retail transaction-value fields. Official current-investor documentation says same-day data is provided after market close: https://github.com/koreainvestment/open-trading-api/tree/main/examples_llm/domestic_stock/investor_trade_by_stock_daily
Existing OpenDART code already persists corpCode.xml identity, paginated disclosures, raw documents, corrections, and next-session fact availability.
assumptions_and_invariants: The full validation window is fixed at 2016-01-04..2016-12-29 and execution needs the next KRX session, 2016-12-30. It must never be shortened.

Decisions occur at KRX close and fills start next session. KRX daily totals are usable at session close. Because KIS documents same-day investor data only after close, session S flow becomes usable at the next KRX open; the flow factor at S uses 20 sessions ending at S-1.
retrieved_at/ingested_at describe local collection only and must never be substituted for or clamped into economic available_at.

Presence in an official historical KRX base-info page proves listed membership for that snapshot. It does not prove suspension/management/liquidation status. Champion v1 does not fabricate those unsupported filters; missing/non-positive executable bars and liquidity block orders.

Instrument/session source gaps cause local exclusion. Hash/schema/time-order/provider-route failures are global. A run may proceed with local gaps only when every validation session retains at least QvefFeaturePolicy.minimum_sector_cohort fully usable candidates.
No historical eligible-count target is hard-coded. The policy-sized daily cohort and non-empty Gold feature artifact are the structural completion criteria.
Credentials load from .env or process environment once and never enter logs, hashes, receipts, or artifacts.

coverage_contract.calendar_window: history_start is index(first_validation)-max(WARMUP_SESSIONS, UniversePolicy.liquidity_window_sessions, 20); execution_end is the next KRX session after validation_end
coverage_contract.master: every planned KRX session through execution_end, exact ticker identity, KOSPI/KOSDAQ market, share class and LIST_DD; historical membership never comes from a current snapshot
coverage_contract.market: every planned KRX session from history_start through execution_end; every row contains raw OHLC, volume, trading_value, MKTCAP and LIST_SHRS; no weekend calls and no inferred cap/shares
coverage_contract.actions: per-instrument interval coverage from history_start through execution_end; compact contiguous no_action ranges, preserve gaps and every real split/consolidation/dividend event
coverage_contract.dart: exact ticker↔corp_code bridge, all periodic filings/corrections through validation_end, and fiscal-period union 2014Q3..2016Q3 so each decision can form trailing-four-quarter and prior-year comparisons
coverage_contract.flow: freeze the union of instruments non-flow-eligible on at least one validation session, then collect KIS from history_start through validation_end in resumable symbol/session chunks
coverage_contract.costs: effective-dated cost rules cover every execution session

reuse_plan: calendar: reuse hash-valid Bronze and rebuild Silver
security_master: reuse official, complete historical Bronze; KRX top-up only missing planned sessions
daily_market: recollect from KRX because Bronze cannot reproduce cap/shares
corporate_actions: reuse and compact retained Bronze if interval audit passes
disclosures: reuse complete verified pages plus targeted incremental collection
investor_flow: KIS collection for frozen candidate union; current 3-symbol Silver is probe-only
historical_costs: reuse verified Bronze and rebuild Silver
execution_phases: 01 inventory/plan: verify receipt hashes/schemas, derive exact sessions and fiscal periods, classify reuse/top-up/recollect, persist immutable plan_id before network calls

02 preflight: load .env without logging secrets; probe one 2016 KRX market/master session, representative KIS historical symbols, and OpenDART identity/disclosure access; stop before bulk calls on failure
03 non-flow collection: KRX only on planned sessions; reuse/compact actions and costs; resume targeted DART batches; every chunk ends as complete, source_unavailable, retryable_failure, or invalid
04 preliminary Silver/candidate freeze: normalize provider-specific available_at, publish non-flow tables atomically, compute union of PIT non-flow-eligible instruments and hash it into the flow plan
05 KIS flow: collect only frozen candidates with raw-page receipts, provider-rate pacing, deterministic checkpoints, and no KRX substitution
06 final Silver/readiness: normalize flow and publish all tables atomically; write table/instrument/session coverage plus exclusion reasons; never select an incomplete dataset as latest
07 Gold/backtest: build all 246 sessions, require policy-sized usable cohort each session and non-empty features, then run next-session smoke backtest linked to exact plan/Silver/Gold hashes

artifact_contract.atomicity: Only result.json with certifiable=true marks completion. Failed/interrupted runs retain immutable Bronze and checkpoints but never publish a partial latest Silver or completed result.

wiring.anchor: # Align batch-ingestion available_at timestamps if present

requirements: Remove KRX fetch_investor_flow/fetch_status_and_actions from the full path. Provider routing is closed and exact.
Iterate only the immutable KRX session tuple. Empty planned-session responses fail coverage; weekends/holidays are not called.
KRX daily Bronze preserves raw responses and rejects missing/non-positive/non-finite MKTCAP or LIST_SHRS before persistence. Never reconstruct either field.

historical_available_at maps KRX daily to session close, KRX master/actions to session open, KIS flow to next KRX open, and DART to the first KRX session after published_at when intraday proof is absent. It never reads receipt.retrieved_at.
Delete Gold's future-available_at rewriting. Rows after a consuming decision remain unavailable or fail readiness; downstream repair is forbidden.
QVEF selects the latest 20 calendar sessions whose KIS data is available at decision time; for session S close this ends at S-1. Each needs one finite KIS row and positive trading_value.
KIS source_unavailable receipts are audit evidence, not completed checkpoints. Auth/quota/transport/schema failures are retryable_failure or invalid, not source_unavailable.
Freeze the KIS candidate union from PIT-safe non-flow eligibility across all validation sessions, without using future returns or final status.
DART must cover every page/correction and 2014Q3..2016Q3 canonical facts with exact ticker↔corp_code only.
Corporate-action gaps exclude only affected instrument-sessions. A global sentinel never supplies coverage.
status='listed' may be emitted only for an issue present in an official historical base-info snapshot; unsupported status labels are never fabricated.
Local gaps are permitted only if every validation session has at least QvefFeaturePolicy.minimum_sector_cohort fully complete candidates. Any sub-threshold session or zero-row Gold fails.
Every checkpoint stores plan hash and all Bronze receipt hashes and revalidates payload digests before reuse. Changed inputs/root or corrupted/missing receipts are pending.
Normalization and result publication are atomic, idempotent, content-addressed, and resumable. Partial datasets never become latest certified outputs.

Operational logs stay under logs/, use one INFO line per phase and flat [DATA] key=value diagnostics with routes, chunks, counts, states and hashes; logs/artifacts contain no API keys, tokens, authorization headers or secret-bearing URLs.
Unit/integration tests perform no network calls. Real probes and the full collection are explicit operational acceptance steps.

design_rationale.alternatives_considered: Adding only MKTCAP/LIST_SHRS was rejected because unsupported routing and invalid PIT availability still prevent completion. Recollecting everything was rejected because verified calendar/action/disclosure/cost evidence can be reused. Requiring every listed stock was rejected because legitimate per-instrument history gaps recreate the all-zero result; treating every gap as optional was rejected because a strategy without a policy-sized daily cohort is unusable.
design_rationale.chosen_reason: One content-addressed state machine fixes source ownership, session scheduling, PIT time semantics, deterministic reuse and local/global readiness. Expensive KIS flow is collected only after the non-flow candidate union is frozen, while financial correctness remains fail-closed.
failure_modes: 2026 retrieval time is rewritten to 2016 or same-day unpublished KIS flow leaks into features
a weekend empty response or unsupported KRX route aborts collection
a negative KIS receipt certifies missing flow as zero
inferred cap/shares are reused without reproducible Bronze
one sentinel or one instrument gap removes the whole cross-section
resume skips corrupted receipts or publishes partial Silver

performance_budget.expected_data_scale: about 307 warmup+validation+execution sessions; ~2,100 KRX instruments/session (~0.65M daily rows); candidate union near observed 1,184 (~0.36M KIS rows); 1GB action JSON; targeted DART 2014Q3..2016Q3
performance_budget.storage_format: immutable Bronze JSON/archive; manifest-verified Hive Parquet Silver/Gold; small JSON plan/checkpoint/readiness artifacts
performance_budget.dtype_precision: float64 for prices, values, cap, shares, action factors and facts; parse integer/string source fields losslessly first
performance_budget.chunking_strategy: KRX per session/page; KIS per symbol/session chunk; DART per corp-code/filing batch; streaming action compaction; atomic table/month Parquet publish
performance_budget.acceleration_candidate: out-of-core Polars scans and partition pruning; provider concurrency must remain inside documented rate limits

def test_derive_historical_collection_window_keeps_full_validation_and_next_execution_session() -> None:
    from datetime import date, timedelta
    from src.data.collection_plan import derive_historical_collection_window

    sessions = tuple(date(2015, 10, 1) + timedelta(days=i) for i in range(63))
    result = derive_historical_collection_window(sessions=sessions, validation_start=sessions[60], validation_end=sessions[61], warmup_sessions=60)

    assert result.history_start == sessions[0]
    assert result.validation_start == sessions[60]
    assert result.validation_end == sessions[61]
    assert result.execution_end == sessions[62]
    assert result.sessions == sessions

def test_historical_available_at_separates_market_close_and_next_session_flow() -> None:
    from datetime import datetime
    from src.core.time import KRX_TZ, SessionCalendar
    from src.data.schemas import EvidenceKind
    from src.data.streaming_normalization import historical_available_at

    calendar = SessionCalendar((datetime(2016, 1, 4, 9, tzinfo=KRX_TZ), datetime(2016, 1, 5, 9, tzinfo=KRX_TZ)))
    record = {'session': '2016-01-04', 'retrieved_at': '2026-09-05T00:00:00+00:00'}
    market_at = historical_available_at(kind=EvidenceKind.DAILY_MARKET, record=record, calendar=calendar)
    flow_at = historical_available_at(kind=EvidenceKind.INVESTOR_FLOW, record=record, calendar=calendar)

    assert (market_at.hour, market_at.minute, market_at.date().isoformat()) == (15, 30, '2016-01-04')
    assert (flow_at.hour, flow_at.minute, flow_at.date().isoformat()) == (9, 0, '2016-01-05')

scenarios.expected_behavior: Unusable historical availability is rejected and unchanged.
scenarios.test_skeleton:
def test_gold_rejects_future_availability_instead_of_rewriting_it() -> None:
    from datetime import UTC, datetime
    import polars as pl
    import pytest
    from src.data.gold import _assert_no_availability_repair
    from src.data.schemas import PITDataError

    future = datetime(2026, 9, 5, tzinfo=UTC)
    frame = pl.DataFrame({'available_at': [future]})
    with pytest.raises(PITDataError, match='daily_market.*available_at'):
        _assert_no_availability_repair(table_name='daily_market', frame=frame, final_decision_time=datetime(2016, 12, 29, 6, 30, tzinfo=UTC))
    assert frame.item(0, 'available_at') == future

scenarios.expected_behavior: A local gap remains reported; the daily structural cohort decides global readiness.
scenarios.test_skeleton:
def test_readiness_allows_local_gaps_only_with_policy_sized_daily_cohort(tmp_path) -> None:
    from datetime import date
    from src.data.collection_plan import EvidenceCoverage, audit_historical_readiness, build_historical_collection_plan
    from src.data.schemas import EvidenceKind

    session = date(2016, 1, 4)
    plan = build_historical_collection_plan(sessions=(session,), universe=({'symbol': '005930', 'is_common_stock': True},), start=session, end=session, artifact_root=tmp_path / 'plans')
    gap = EvidenceCoverage(kind=EvidenceKind.INVESTOR_FLOW, instrument_id='KRX:000001', session=session, state='source_unavailable', receipt_hash='a' * 64, reason='provider_has_no_history')
    passing = audit_historical_readiness(plan=plan, coverage=(gap,), usable_feature_count_by_session={session: 10}, minimum_cohort=10)
    failing = audit_historical_readiness(plan=plan, coverage=(gap,), usable_feature_count_by_session={session: 9}, minimum_cohort=10)

    assert passing.certifiable is True
    assert passing.coverage_gaps
    assert failing.certifiable is False
    assert any('usable cohort' in reason for reason in failing.unresolved_reasons)
